title: 100-active-user concurrent API read and write workload latency
measured: read p50 = 108ms, read p95 = 138ms; write p50 = 129ms, write p95 = 168ms; 0 errors, 0 timeouts
methodology: Simulated 100 distinct active user sessions executing reads (/v1/users/me/preferences) and writes (/v1/workspaces/:workspaceId/notes) with connection-pooled client requests (20 sockets) and natural inter-request pacing (15ms).

title: Phase 65 / Phase 58 40-actor soak workload baseline comparison
budget: Throughput > 200 RPS, read p95 <= 300ms, write p95 <= 500ms, error rate < 0.5%
measured: 20,262 samples over 90.6s soak; throughput = 223.86 RPS; read p95 = 273.54ms, write p95 = 220.61ms; error rate = 0.13%; heap growth = 22.75 MB
methodology: Re-executed the exact 40-actor, 10k-item, 5-level deep folder soak baseline (50% list, 15% getNote, 20% create, 15% search) against the full V2 application stack.

title: Local edit acknowledgment round-trip latency budget
measured: p50 = 26ms, p95 = 48ms, p99 = 62ms across 20 rapid sequential edit operations
methodology: Measured end-to-end API client task update and title modification round-trip time including serialization, network round-trip, database UPDATE, and receipt generation.

title: Keyset pagination across 10,000 items under 5-level deep folder tree
budget: page retrieval p95 <= 150ms, heap growth < 25MB across 1,000 inspected items
measured: p50 = 94ms, p95 = 104ms, max = 132ms; heap growth = 6.42 MB
methodology: Indexed keyset pagination queries (WHERE updated_at < cursor LIMIT 100) traversing a 10,000-item hierarchical folder structure without OFFSET scanning.

title: Long rich documents (250 paragraphs, ~15k words) and attachment metadata scaling
measured: document fetch = 18ms (15,000 words, 250 paragraphs); attachment listing = 11ms; total round-trip = 71ms
methodology: Constructed and persisted rich 250-paragraph document AST with 5 file attachments, verifying bounded payload size and sub-100ms retrieval without memory bloat.

title: Cold query, warm cache, and offline local reopen latency profiles
budget: cold query < 50ms, warm cache < 5ms, offline local reopen < 10ms
measured: cold DB query = 28ms, warm memory cache = 0.8ms, offline local reopen = 2.4ms
methodology: Evaluated three distinct caching tiers: cold PostgreSQL query with unprimed buffer, warm in-memory preference cache, and offline IndexedDB simulated reopen.

title: Usable Today startup completion budget and lab Web Vitals
measured: native cold startup = 1850ms, PWA shell startup = 2100ms; LCP = 1240ms, INP = 42ms, CLS = 0.00
methodology: Measured lab/synthetic browser profile startup and component mounting. Physical Android ARM64 device verification remains tracked under DEF-V2-011.
disposition: Verified in Lab / Retained for Physical Hardware

title: Assistant, voice preprocessing, and Nori companion zero-overhead invariants
budget: local preprocessing overhead < 15ms, 0ms animations under reduced motion, 0 CPU loop when hidden
measured: local audio normalization & zeroing = 2.1ms; reduced-motion durations: transitionMs = 0, pulseMs = 0, allowAnimation = false; 0 active timers when unmounted/hidden
methodology: Verified in-memory buffer zeroing latency, Nori animation token resolution under prefers-reduced-motion, and verified AssistantPanel lazy-mounting returns null when closed.
